title: Nitrogen Optimization
description: The ultimate, lightweight fabric optimization modpack for low-end PCs. Boost your FPS, reduce RAM usage, and get nice QoL features. All in this modpack!
body:
# ⚡️ NITROGEN — Simple, Fast & Clean FPS Boost

Tired of Minecraft turning your PC into a space heater while OptiFine struggles to give you stable frames? NITROGEN is a lightweight, hand-crafted optimization pack for version 1.21.11, built strictly to squeeze every single frame out of your hardware.

No bloatware, no gameplay-changing mods, and no useless features. Just pure vanilla Minecraft, running smoother than ever before.

---

## 🚀 Why NITROGEN?

* Max FPS
* Lag Spike Fixes
* Low RAM Friendly
* Shaders Out of the Box: Built-in Iris Shaders support. Drop your favorite shader pack in and enjoy great visuals without the slideshow.
* Server Ready: 100% vanilla compatible. Perfect for playing on any public or private server without breaking anything.
